observations: Photo 0 shows two large metal transmission/gearbox housings standing on a dusty concrete floor, each with 'F15' handwritten in white paint/chalk on the casing.
A separate round metal component resembling a torque converter sits to the left in photo 0.
Photo 1 and 2 are close-ups of the same 'F15' chalk marking on one gearbox casing; no manufacturer logo, casting number, or part-number plate is legible.
Units show grease, grime, and corrosion typical of used/salvage parts; no visible impact damage.
A 'GRIDEX INVESTMENT' watermark overlays all three photos; no scale reference or stand for size/weight confirmation.
Wiring harness connectors are visible near the gearboxes but their completeness/condition cannot be judged.

identity.kind: used automatic/manual transmission gearbox unit (seller claims BMW X5 F15)

claims.claim: This is a BMW Gearbox for X5 F15
claims.evidence: Only a hand-written chalk 'F15' mark is visible in photos 0-2; no BMW logo, casting number, or OEM part-number plate is legible to confirm make/model or exact variant.

claims.claim: All BMW Engine and Gearbox parts available now with affordable price
claims.evidence: No photo shows an inventory of engines or additional gearbox parts beyond what is pictured; this is a general sales statement, not something a photo can confirm.

risks.proof: Clear close-up of the factory casting number or OEM part-number sticker/plate on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified/generic used gearbox, not as a confirmed BMW X5 F15 unit

risks.risk: Mechanical condition/functionality unknown (no spin test, no fluid check, no video of shifting).
risks.proof: A short video showing the gearbox being turned by hand or bench-tested, plus fluid condition check.

risks.risk: Unclear whether this is an automatic or manual unit, and which exact drivetrain variant (xDrive/2WD, diesel/petrol) it fits.
risks.proof: Photo of the transmission's full profile including input/output shaft ends and any BMW type-code sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified/generic variant, lowest compatible tier

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal (accident, failure, or routine swap) unknown.
risks.proof: Seller-provided donor vehicle documentation or mileage log.

risks.risk: Multiple similar gearboxes are shown together; buyer cannot be sure which exact unit will be shipped.
risks.proof: Photo with a tag or serial number matching the listing, placed directly on the specific unit for sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming the lowest-condition unit among those shown

proof_requests: Close-up of the factory casting/part number plate on the gearbox housing
Video of the gearbox being hand-turned or bench-tested to show it is not seized
Photo confirming automatic vs manual type and shaft configuration
Any documentation tying this specific unit to a BMW X5 F15 donor vehicle
response.reason: The only identifying mark is a hand-written chalk 'F15' label with no legible BMW casting number, part plate, or logo, so the exact model/variant that sets the price cannot be confirmed from the photos; a clear part-number shot is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
